tools.name: search-knowledge
tools.title: Search Knowledge Tool
tools.description:
Search the company knowledge base (wiki) for articles the acting user may see.
    Returns id, title, breadcrumb, a snippet, is_published and, for condensed
    articles, the source they came from.

    Most of this wiki is condensed from closed tickets, and those articles are
    drafts, so drafts are searched too unless published_only is set. Pass
    source_type "ticket" to search only knowledge that came out of tickets.

    Use it to answer questions from existing company knowledge before guessing.

query.description: What to look up in the knowledge base.

source_type.description: Only articles condensed from this source, e.g. "ticket" or "order".

published_only.description: Skip drafts. Off by default, because condensed knowledge is unpublished.

limit.description: Maximum number of articles to return (default: 25, max: 100).

tools.name: show-knowledge-article
tools.title: Show Knowledge Article Tool
tools.description:
Read the full markdown of a single knowledge base article by id. Only returns
    articles the acting user may see. Drafts are readable, since condensed ticket
    knowledge is unpublished by design; is_published says which one you got.

id.description: The knowledge article id, e.g. from search-knowledge.

tools.name: create-knowledge-article
tools.title: Create Knowledge Article Tool
tools.description:
Write a new article into the knowledge base. Give it a title and the body as
    markdown. It is created as a draft unless is_published is set, so a human
    reviews it before it counts as company knowledge.

    Only capture reusable knowledge, not one-off customer details. When the article
    summarises a ticket or an order, pass source_type and source_id so the article
    stays traceable back to it.

is_published.description: Publish right away instead of leaving a draft. Defaults to a draft.

source_type.description: Morph alias of what this was condensed from, e.g. "ticket".

source_id.description: Id of the source record named by source_type.

change_summary.description: Short note on where this article came from, kept with the version.

tools.name: update-knowledge-article
tools.title: Update Knowledge Article Tool
tools.description:
Revise an existing knowledge base article. Pass only what changes; the previous
    state is kept as a version. Refuses articles the acting user may not see and
    articles that are locked.

id.description: Id of the article to revise, e.g. from search-knowledge.

title.description: New title. Left as is when omitted.

content_markdown.description: New body as markdown. Left as is when omitted.

change_summary.description: Short note on what changed, kept with the version.
